notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl, standard browser UA) succeeded for every page, no WAF/blocking (matches the prior Home-Decor/Textile/Pet-Care passes on this same SR). robots.txt (https://www.juttu.be/robots.txt) checked first: no Claude/Anthropic-specific disallow, generic 'User-agent: *' rules only disallow /api*, /account*, /checkout*, /lister.html* (search-results path) etc - no block on category pages. DISCOVERY: Juttu.be is JBC's multi-department lifestyle/gift store (fashion + home-deco + books/media + food + personal care); this SR covers the whole domain since Seasonal has no product-type restriction (rules 7). Built the candidate list from the union of (1) the full category sitemap https://www.juttu.be/sitemap/category-1.xml (581 URLs, fetched via sitemap/index.xml) grepped for Dutch/French/English seasonal terms (kerst/christmas, pasen/easter, halloween, valentijn/valentine, sinterklaas, diwali, carnaval, advent, nieuwjaar/new year, moederdag/vaderdag, feest/festival, lente/zomer/herfst/winter/season) and (2) the home-deco mega-menu tree and the cadeaus (gifts) and boeken (books) branches. Each candidate page was fetched directly and its embedded AEMScenes_ProductLister JSON (server-rendered React/Hypernova payload, same field the site's own filter/pagination UI reads) inspected for the {categories:c(...ids...), totalPages, itemCount} block tied to that specific category-tree node id - this is the exact qty source, cross-checked twice per page (SSR block appears once server-side and once client-hydration, always matched). FOUND (kept, category = English holiday name per rules 19): Christmas (home-deco/kerst.html, node 9319;10414, parent grouping row - genuine nav parent with 4 real children) > Christmas Tree Decorations/Christmas Decorations/Christmas Tableware/Christmas Cards, all itemCount=0 on every check (site's own live query, not a display bug - Easter/Spring/Summer nodes on the identical infrastructure returned real non-zero counts in the same sweep) - kept as qty:0 zero rows per the Textile/Storage precedent on this same company (ts115.json, same AEMScenes_ProductLister mechanism) rather than dropped, since the category demonstrably exists, is live, and the 0 is itself evidence (most likely explanation: Christmas assortment not yet stocked this early in September, well before the seasonal launch window); a second, separate 'Kerstkaarten' node exists under Boeken > Wenskaarten (node 11172;11614;12647, itemCount=7) - NOT a duplicate of the home-deco Kerstkaarten node (different node id, different count, no shared facet breakdown), kept as its own row. New Year (Boeken > Wenskaarten > Nieuwjaarskaartjes, node 11172;11614;12651, itemCount=0) - same live-zero treatment. Easter (home-deco/pasen.html, node 9319;12150, itemCount=23). Spring (home-deco/lente.html, node 9319;12692, itemCount=39) and Summer (home-deco/zomer.html, node 9319;12721, itemCount=88) - both explicitly allowed as genuine seasonal-shopping-period categories per rules 3; each is a real product-lister page (not a pure lookbook/banner page - has its own facet-scoped category id and multi-widget landing layout with a genuine product grid underneath). Valentine's Day (cadeaus/gelegenheid/valentijn.html, node 11896;11974;12287, itemCount=103). Saint Nicholas / Sinterklaas (cadeaus/gelegenheid/sinterklaas.html, node 11896;11974;12592, itemCount=777 - major Belgian Dec-6 gift-giving holiday, largest seasonal node found). Mother's Day (cadeaus/gelegenheid/moederdag.html, node 11896;11974;11975, itemCount=145) and Father's Day (cadeaus/gelegenheid/vaderdag.html, node 11896;11974;11976, itemCount=106) - both explicitly listed as valid in rules 3. Mother's Day & Father's Day (Boeken > Wenskaarten > Moeder en vaderdag, node 11172;11614;12650, itemCount=14) - the site combines both occasions into one greeting-card listing (page content confirms both 'moederdag' and 'vaderdag' referenced), recorded as one joint-name row rather than fabricating a split that doesn't exist on the site. EXCLUDED after inspection (rules 4-6, 20): cadeaus/gelegenheid siblings Verjaardag (Birthday, itemCount=1630), Housewarming (itemCount=347) and Juf en meester (Teacher gift, itemCount=28) - genuine live PLPs but not calendar holidays/seasons (birthday and housewarming can occur any day of the year; 'for teachers' is a persona/profession gift page, not a recognised seasonal occasion), same reasoning class as the 'voor-wie' persona pages already excluded on this company in the Pet-Care pass. Boeken/Wenskaarten siblings Liefdeskaartjes (itemCount=24, checked page content for any Valentijn tie-in - none found, genuine generic 'love cards' product type usable year-round, not a Valentine's-specific node), Geboortekaartjes (birth announcement cards, not seasonal), Verjaardagskaarten (birthday cards, not seasonal), Rouwkaartjes (condolence cards, not seasonal), and the Wenskaarten parent itself (mixed general/seasonal, not itself a single holiday). Home-deco/media/kalenders.html (Calendars, itemCount=9) - checked product names, this is a regular yearly/tear-off calendar assortment (nature, cycling, cat-themed, etc.), not an Advent/Christmas-specific listing, despite incidental 'advent' string hits elsewhere on the page (non-product boilerplate) - excluded as a normal product-type category, not seasonal. Home-deco/kerst/cadeaus-inpakken.html - 301-redirects to a general, non-Christmas-specific cadeaus/inpakken-en-kaartjes.html (gift wrap & cards) - excluded as no longer a Christmas-specific node. korting-for-ju/kerstdecoratie.html, korting-for-ju/home-deco.html, mid-season-madness/*, ronde-prijzen/home-deco.html - discount/sale/price-gimmick branches (korting=discount, ronde-prijzen=round prices), excluded per the Sale/Offers/Clearance exclusion. kleding/feestkledij.html (party clothing), kleding/jurken/feest-jurken.html and zomer-jurken.html (party/summer dresses) - seasonal-flavoured style words on ordinary clothing product types, not site-designated holiday categories, excluded per rules 5-6. NOT FOUND despite a full sitemap keyword sweep + direct URL probes (404 on /home-deco/halloween.html and /cadeaus/gelegenheid/halloween.html) + nav/mega-menu check: Halloween, Diwali, Thanksgiving, Carnival/Carnaval, Black Friday, Advent-specific listings - none exist anywhere in the 581-URL category sitemap or the visible nav; treated as genuinely absent, not unchecked (rules 12).
